description: Fork of exp030 (MultiBit K=4) with tph and output_nap restored to exp026 levels — full votes/pair budget, no halving. Tests pure K=4 vs K=1 question at matched vote density. Q/K joint: tph=512, output_nap=24/side=48 → votes/pair=24.8 (matches exp026/exp020). V: tph=512, output_nap=16 → votes/pair=68.3 (matches exp026/exp020). out_proj: tph=2048, output_nap=32 → votes/pair=25.6 (matches exp026/exp020). K=4 with same latent count as exp026 (138M latents). Reference baseline: exp026 (K=1, same geometry) = 1.8415 final. If exp031 ≤ 1.8415, K=4 wins at matched votes/pair. If ≥, K=4 hurts (probably quantization noise in the latent → 16-level rounding).
